text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Now! Raise your glasses, everyone! 
To the long-awaited BBQ—nay, Beach Party!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Your only duty today is to have fun with 
all your might! 
Please, let loose, reflect on our training 
camp, and laugh together!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "—Cheers!"

text_block_list.name: Energetic Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"—Hey, hey! They're doing beach flags over 
there! 
Let's go join in!"

text_block_list.name: Neat and Proper Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"—Shall we chat under the parasol? 
It's quiet there, and we'll have a great 
view of the sea."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Suzuka!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Air Groove."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Are you having fun? These carrots are 
delicious—you're today's 
star of the show, so eat up! ...Ah, that 
was a bit too loud, wasn't it."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, Pokke was eager to 
play beach volleyball. 
I was invited as well... How about you? Of 
course, no pressure—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Sure, maybe I'll join."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh, is that so? 
I wouldn't have imagined that from you 
when you first arrived at training camp."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Really?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. ...Do you remember? 
It took you quite some time to adjust to 
dorm life, too."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"『Silence Suzuka! How many times do I 
have to tell you? Respect the evening 
curfew, 
get back earlier from your morning runs, 
and stop skipping meals!』"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"『Well... when I run, I lose track of 
everything around me. 
...I'm sorry.』"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"『Right, just be careful next time. 
And... even if it's just once in a while. 
Try to talk to the other dorm 
residents.』"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"『You're both free-spirited and quiet. 
Some people are mistaking you for a 
delinquent—they're actually scared of 
you.』"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "『Y-You're kidding...』"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"『I'm not. ...Regardless, in a closed 
dorm environment, it's always best to have 
good relationships. Try to be a little 
more mindful of it.』"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even back then, I only made the 
suggestion. You were the one who put in 
the effort.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Though you still forgot from time to time, 
you watched the clock, ate your meals... 
And whenever the other residents spoke to 
you, you answered, even if hesitantly—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, the misunderstanding cleared 
up, and your expression softened too. 
—I was surprised when I saw you taking 
part in dorm events, you know.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"『Hey, Air Groove. Can I tell you 
something a little strange?』"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"『That's unusual for you. ...What is 
it?』"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"『—When I come back at night, the dorm 
windows are glowing like that, right? 
...I know, they're just lights that happen 
to be on.』"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"『Even so... 
Whenever I see them, it feels like they're 
saying, "Welcome home."』"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"『..."Welcome home," "Good work today." 
And then, "Have a good day tomorrow, 
too."』"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"『It gives me this... warm, ticklish 
feeling, and it makes me happy. 
...Hehe, I'm weird, aren't I?』"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I was so glad... to see you adjust to 
life at the dorm, make memories, 
and eventually come to see it as a place 
where you truly belonged."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Is that how it was?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...You're always looking out for me 
behind the scenes, aren't you, Air Groove? 
Thank you. Going that far for my sake—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...No, not this time. 
...Looking back, half of it was for 
myself."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "For yourself?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"............ 
I wanted you to be a part of my memories, 
too."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted summer days spent together with 
you. 
So that one day, I would be able to look 
back on them clearly."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"So perhaps I was merely nudging you for 
my own sake. 
............No, forget I said that. It was 
foolish of me."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "...Hehe, no, it wasn't. Thank you."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I feel like... I won't ever be able to 
forget those words. Ever.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(And after that, I had a meal with Air 
Groove, 
played beach volleyball with Pokke and the 
others—)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Watching my friends laughing and smiling 
on the beach, 
the sun had set before I even knew it.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone's aboard. 
Let's head out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vrrrroooom...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
All that energy from earlier feels like a 
dream... 
I wonder if yesterday's fatigue finally 
caught up with them...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
More likely... the tension simply 
snapped... 
Living in unfamiliar territory, fun as it 
is, naturally builds up stress...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Knowing we're heading back to the 
academy... relaxes me... *yawn*... 
...I should... stay awake... before we 
get...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(...Yesterday's scenery is still burned 
into my mind. 
...That sun-drenched, blue, lively world—)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure, I just know... I'll never 
forget it...)
